good.headline: Molbio Diagnostics Stock Soars 9% As It Becomes Jefferies Top Med Tech Pick At Initiation
good.plain: A big company called Jefferies said Molbio is a great pick, so more people want to buy its shares.

good.headline: Molbio Diagnostics shares rally 9% as Jefferies initiates 'high conviction top pick' call for recently lis
good.plain: Jefferies strongly believes in Molbio and says it’s a top choice, making investors excited.

good.headline: Molbio gains 9% as Jefferies assigns 'Buy' tag on innovation-led model
good.plain: Jefferies told people to buy Molbio shares because it makes cool new medical tests.

good.headline: Molbio Diagnostics shares jump 5% as HDFC MF buys 1.99% stake via bulk deal | Newly listed stock up 71% from IPO price
good.plain: A trusted fund bought a part of Molbio, showing confidence, and the stock is already up a lot since it started trading.

bad.headline: India Business Excellence Fund III sells 2.06% stake in Molbio Diagnostics
bad.plain: A fund sold part of its shares in Molbio, which might make others worry.

bad.headline: Motilal Oswal Alternates sells over 2% stake in Molbio Diagnostics for ₹306 cr
bad.plain: Another big seller dumped a lot of Molbio shares, which could push the price down.
